Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE square canonical Strength Ledger movement photograph for mobile cards and exact movement history. INPUT 1 is the approved ORIGINAL Incline Dumbbell Bench Press and the immutable, sole visual style control. Preserve its premium near-black studio, dark subtly textured floor, natural muscular adult athlete in graphite sleeveless shirt, black shorts and plain black shoes, believable skin/fabric, neutral brushed-silver equipment, broad neutral key and restrained violet rear-right rim. Same commercial fitness photography and normal-to-short-telephoto lens feel. Movement mechanics dictate a new camera/pose; do not copy the incline press pose. No new blue palette, fog, neon, shirtless posing, branding, text, numbers, watermarks, anatomy highlights or gym clutter. One athlete only, natural proportions, neutral focused expression, two anatomically plausible hands with wrapped grips, physically coherent implements and support/contact shadows. Fit the WHOLE athlete, both complete shoes, all weights/bar ends and bench/support feet within the square with about 8% breathing room; action occupies roughly 80–85% of longest image axis, not a tiny figure. Never cut off or merge equipment. Preserve full photographic detail and strong implement/torso/arm silhouette for downscaling.
Canonical MovementDefinition 335. LEVER BAR SUPINATION, bilateral synchronized representation. Seated athlete both forearms supported on thighs nearhorizontal, hands beyond knees. Each hand grips near bare unweighted end of ONE short straight lever bar, ONE small silver disc secured at far end. Rotate BOTH forearms OUTWARD so palms face visibly UP and weighted tips tilt OUTWARD away from center about45 degrees from vertical. Wrists stay straight, thumbs turn outward, elbows stay fixed. Front elevated camera clearly reveals palm-up grip and outward separated weighted levers, complete seated athlete/bench and both bar tips. Different from inward palm-down pronation. CORRECT INPUT 2: Reposition both forearms along the TOPS of thighs, wrists beyond knees, elbows stationary; hands in front of knees, not out beside hips. Palms fully face UP. Each single-ended lever projects OUTWARD to its same side nearly horizontally, loaded tips just10degrees ABOVE hands. Wrists straight, no wrist bend or shoulder rotation. Show underhand forearm rotation and coherent fingers, supported forearms unmistakable. Keep full athlete, bench and original light.
